tests.name: queue_alert_findings_never_alerts_when_intentional_hold
tests.rationale: Queue pause or maintenance mode is intentional and should suppress active-lane hang findings for arbitrary stale-looking active rows.

tests.name: queue_alert_findings_handles_model_worker_observation_shapes
tests.rationale: Worker observations may be model objects or dicts and live run evidence should suppress stale active row findings.
tests.code:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from types import SimpleNamespace
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from enoch_control_plane.control_plane.alerts import queue_alert_findings
from enoch_control_plane.control_plane.models import DashboardObservationRecord

@given(st.text(min_size=1, max_size=30))
def test_queue_alert_findings_handles_model_worker_observation_shapes(run_id):
    obs = DashboardObservationRecord(source='worker_preflight', status='warn', payload={'checks': [{'name': 'wake_gate_runs', 'data': {'body': {'runs': [{'run_id': run_id, 'is_live': True}]}}}]})
    status = SimpleNamespace(flags=SimpleNamespace(queue_paused=False, maintenance_mode=False), config=SimpleNamespace(live_dispatch_enabled=True), conflicts=[], active_items=[{'project_id': 'p', 'current_run_id': run_id, 'updated_at': datetime(2000,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)}], warnings=[], source_freshness={}, observations={'worker_preflight': obs})
    assert queue_alert_findings(status, hang_after_sec=1) == []
